scope: General-purpose ODE solver; local execution; no NCP
ordering: Correctness and same-contract total cost before broader default adoption

items.problem: Historical implicit rate still screens explicit returns and can suppress a real current-window win.
items.implementation: Add an explicitly budgeted occasional same-checkpoint return comparison that bypasses only the historical-rate screen. Reserve its maximum attempt/callback cost before starting; retain all fatal and checkpoint rules. Keep ordinary cheap checks between these sentinels.
items.mathematical_contract: Qualified comparison uses identical checkpoint, interval, physical error requirement and cost units. A scheduling heuristic is not a stiffness certificate. Reserve post-callback overshoot as well as the nominal limit.
acceptance: Adversarial old-implicit=10, current-explicit=20, current-implicit=100 example is recognized when the sentinel is due
Actual time-varying ODE counterpart passes common full-state error cap
No unbounded probing, unauthorized derivatives, fatal retry or uncharged work
Total selected-run cost is compared with sentinel disabled and an appropriate direct route
items.default_policy: Opt in until measured benefit exceeds comparison overhead.

items.problem: Implicit coalescing and mean-step warm starts still recreate state between native calls.
items.implementation: Expose an accepted-checkpoint RODAS session preserving the proposal, previous accepted error, last rejected trial, rejection_pending state, workspace, counters and eligible caches. Invalidate numerical caches on model/provider/metric/mesh identity changes; workspace capacity may remain.
items.mathematical_contract: For fixed callback environment, arithmetic order and identical forced landing times, preserving complete state gives the same attempt sequence as uninterrupted execution. A mean h alone does not meet this contract.
acceptance: Split/resume and uninterrupted runs match accepted/rejected sequence and full counters at identical landing times
Fatal/recoverable callbacks and budget exhaustion preserve last accepted state
Measure 1, 8 and 64 pause windows with allocation counts and total elapsed cost
Reuse no factorization merely because dimensions match
items.default_policy: Adopt only after equivalence tests and incremental benefit beyond current coalescing.

items.problem: RHS count and the fixed work proxy do not represent dense factorization, JVP, allocation and callback costs equally.
items.implementation: Allow a caller to offer multiple authorized equivalent providers with distinct identities and resource ceilings. Calibrate costs only when remaining useful work can amortize calibration, and include calibration/transition charges in selection records. Preserve the ability to supply only JVP without materializing a dense matrix.
items.mathematical_contract: Compare candidate upper cost plus future transition per remaining call against incumbent lower cost. Empirical intervals remain empirical; no universal dense/matrix-free crossover is assumed.
acceptance: Use one physical problem and identical observation contract for backend comparisons
Record RHS/JVP/Jacobian/factorization/solve/allocation work separately
Check provider equivalence independently of cost
Zero matrix and derivative calls when forbidden
A direct dense control is not counted as available when the caller supplied only JVP
items.default_policy: No implicit provider substitution or unconditional JVP preference.

items.problem: The project's derivative-free algebraic and oscillatory constructions remain separate from the ordinary automatic selector.
items.implementation: Add a declared structure-provider interface for quotient flow, involution/chirp and cofactor lifts. Connect each provider's original-state error/reconstruction bound, model/chart epoch, setup cost and fallback to the existing qualified comparison. Retain causal-forward as the first comparison for homotopy/Picard alternatives.
items.mathematical_contract: Certify the original lambda=1 residual and physical error, not only transformed residual. Operator reuse via Q=gamma*W^{-1}(h'J'-hJ) requires a justified norm bound below one or residual-to-error sensitivity control.
acceptance: Include noncommuting carriers, wrong charge support, stale epochs and nearly singular quotient denominators
Compare with the strongest authorized direct route, including setup and certification
Derivative-free routes remain derivative-free; projected causal JVP/small-LU and general homotopy correction are labeled accurately
Reuse unchanged prior proofs and add tests only for new interface hypotheses
items.default_policy: Specialized adaptive candidates, not compulsory general-path preprocessing.

items.problem: Current short pilots qualify endpoint error; default gyromotion misses its physical cap and intermediate-time behavior is not covered.
items.implementation: Register component-scaled trajectory and phase diagnostics at common observation times, keeping endpoint-only and observed-output APIs distinct. Reuse analytic references and independent external references. Never remove required observations to improve timing.
acceptance: Tight and default tolerance cohorts both remain visible
Phase, amplitude and all-component error at shared times
Accuracy-qualified work-precision curves for selected route versus relevant direct control
VODE/DVODE, Diffsol and Julia comparisons only where the complete problem/output/error contract matches
items.default_policy: Do not infer global accuracy from a successful endpoint or local tolerance alone.

items.problem: Prior calibration-inclusive execution experiments did not beat the strongest direct control; small problems can lose to thread and synchronization overhead.
items.implementation: Keep serial execution as the small-work baseline. Test parallel stage or ensemble execution only after a cost estimate includes extra waves, worker startup, synchronization and certificate costs. Reset evidence when worker/model/layout identities change.
acceptance: Compare the adapter's selected execution against one relevant serial/parallel alternative
Use actual model callbacks and separately label synthetic expensive RHS
Report total solve cost with calibration included
Do not claim serial stage emulation demonstrates parallel wall-time speedup
items.default_policy: Specialized opt-in until an amortized total-cost win is observed.

items.problem: Optional provider availability is now handled correctly but its explanation is textual and declaration checks are duplicated.
items.implementation: Extract shared pure declaration validation; add structured requested-permission, effective-permission and unavailability fields with an explicit schema change. Preserve current callback-free preflight and native observed-state equivalence.
acceptance: All existing availability/fatal/budget tests remain valid
Malformed declarations are not silently downgraded
Unknown future restrictions are explicit errors
Downstream consumers need not parse decision strings
items.default_policy: Compatibility-focused follow-up; do not change default derivative permissions.

local_execution.raw_data_source: User's local receipts plus this published packet

model_routing.focused_unresolved_math_or_scientific_di: astra ultra with relevant research skills/plugins only when needed
model_routing.note: Routing preference, not a claim that this packet's native tests were run by a specific model.
